question: What action remains for one who has no death in battle?
premises: Death in battle is absent for me.
The speaker asks what to do.
The absence is total in every way.
inference: The verse expresses bewilderment after invulnerability in battle.
uncertainties: The fused forms nāsīnme and mṛtyuryuddheṣu are segmented by inferred sandhi.
plain_english: Then what do I do? There was no death for me in battles in any way.
